root_acs_disable_experiment_summary.kernel_cmdline_finding: `pcie_acs_override` is an out-of-tree VFIO patch absent in mainline Ubuntu 6.8 kernels; mainline equivalent is `pci=disable_acs_redir=pci:15b3:197c` or runtime `setpci -s <BDF> ECAP_ACS+06.w=0000` + `nvidia.ko` reload.
root_acs_disable_experiment_summary.sm_bar_mmio_ld_st_result: W0R0 (`st.global` dropped + `ld.global` returns `0xFFFFFFFF` PCIe Unsupported Request poison) across all 4 intra-switch PXB pairs `(0,1),(2,3),(4,5),(6,7)` under every ACSCtl mask (`0x0000`, `0x000c`, `0x001c`, `0x001d`).
root_acs_disable_experiment_summary.bidirectional_nccl_p2p_result: Deadlocks on concurrent multi-pair BAR1 P2P across 2-tier PCIe switch + dual-socket UPI due to non-posted/posted PCIe credit dependency loops; all 20 ports restored to `ACSCtl = 0x001d`.
root_acs_disable_experiment_summary.architectural_conclusion: Host DRAM mapped rings (`shm_v5` for CUDAGraph & small/mid M + `NCCL_LOC` for large-M Eager prefill) are hardware-optimal on CX-8 `15b3:197c` topologies.

dsv41_e2e_amdahl_ablation.benchmark_protocol: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash TP=8 on 8x RTX 6000D, b12x=on(moe=40,lin=210/6), --no-enable-prefix-caching, isolated per-(round,tier) seeds, Warm n=3.
dsv41_e2e_amdahl_ablation.engineering_decision: Retain `done-wait` (`my_done` entry spin + `peer_done` exit release store): removing `done-wait` saves only ~0.6-2.0 us/call (~0.05-0.16 ms/step = <2% E2E, inside the <3% GPU boost-clock noise band) while forfeiting unconditional 4-slot ring overwrite safety under future multi-stream overlap. Ship stateless adaptive `256->512` CTA thread scaling + `64 KiB` one-shot threshold + hybrid `NCCL_LOC` large-M Eager routing, which captures the `c=32` wave-tail fix and 2K-4K prefill bandwidth gains with zero ring-safety compromise.
